The carousel carries one additional profile: **Mark Carney (Kent State)**, whose team page shows Year 2. The guide's own text explains why — Carney coached Kent State as an interim in 2025 and had the tag removed mid-season, so he is new to the job without being new to the program (p. 34). This is a definitional difference, not a contradiction; both figures are reported as the guide states them.
